head_commit.message:
Make URLs in asynchronous question titles clickable (#51391)

## What changed

Render web URLs in TUI asynchronous question titles as terminal hyperlinks, preserving the full destination when a URL wraps across lines or is partially clipped. Exclude trailing question punctuation such as `)?` from detected URLs while preserving balanced parentheses and query strings.

## Testing

Add a rendering regression test and snapshot for a wrapped URL, checking complete hyperlink destinations at full and reduced heights. Extend URL detection tests for trailing question punctuation and balanced parentheses in query strings.

head_commit.message:
Keep Guardian v2 WebSocket pools warm with concurrent replenishment (#51378)

## Why

Serial connection opens let a stalled handshake delay healthy sockets. Waiting until the idle pool is empty to refill also leaves classification bursts using HTTP fallback.

## What changed

- Open up to four WebSockets concurrently and start replenishing when the idle pool falls to half capacity. Preserve successful in-flight opens when another open fails or times out.
- Make explicit prewarming wait for an existing refill before checking readiness.
- Add `ResponsesWebsocketClient::connect_with_connector` and reuse one connector per sampler, initializing TLS configuration on a blocking task while retaining per-connection authentication and destination policy checks.
- Record connection lease durations for admission, setup, and total time, tagged by transport.

## Testing

Add regression tests for a stalled handshake alongside a healthy socket and replenishment before the last idle socket is leased. Update cooldown, authentication, and transport retry tests to account for concurrent handshake completion.

head_commit.message:
Keep Guardian v2 WebSocket pools warm with concurrent replenishment (#51378)

## Why

Serial connection opens let a stalled handshake delay healthy sockets. Waiting until the idle pool is empty to refill also leaves classification bursts using HTTP fallback.

## What changed

- Open up to four WebSockets concurrently and start replenishing when the idle pool falls to half capacity. Preserve successful in-flight opens when another open fails or times out.
- Make explicit prewarming wait for an existing refill before checking readiness.
- Add `ResponsesWebsocketClient::connect_with_connector` and reuse one connector per sampler, initializing TLS configuration on a blocking task while retaining per-connection authentication and destination policy checks.
- Record connection lease durations for admission, setup, and total time, tagged by transport.

## Testing

Add regression tests for a stalled handshake alongside a healthy socket and replenishment before the last idle socket is leased. Update cooldown, authentication, and transport retry tests to account for concurrent handshake completion.

head_commit.message:
Add bounded diagnostics for agent spawn failures (#51355)

## Why

Spawn failures can share an error kind and message despite different causes, such as execution and residency capacity limits. Telemetry needs enough detail to distinguish these failures without using error messages or correlation IDs as metric labels.

## What changed

- Add `AgentErrorContext` annotations for capacity limits, registry rejections, runtime availability, and spawn stages. Preserve the first annotation so outer stages retain the more precise failure origin.
- Add bounded `detail` and `error_kind` labels to spawn failure metrics, using `unknown` when no context is available.
- Emit spawn failure trace events with these classifications and the call and turn IDs for both multi-agent versions.

## Testing

Add tests for distinct capacity and registry failure contexts, preservation of manager, fork, and shutdown errors, and metric aggregation across different error messages and correlation IDs. Verify that annotations preserve existing error kinds and user-visible messages.
